style.backgroundSystem: matte sage green wall #8FA795 for mood scenes, clean white #FFFFFF for info screens, deep night blue #1C2733 for quiet night scenes, charcoal #2B2B2B detail-module ground carrying rounded light-grey #F2F3F2 cards

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh green clean-air appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sage green #8FA795, deep night blue #1C2733, one mint accent #9BD4B8 and charcoal text #2D2D2D kept for typography on light grounds; bright soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows, low-key dim glow for night scenes; modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting; consistent thin-line icons with small mint accent fills; rounded light-grey info cards on charcoal for detail modules; upright stable product presentation at true-life scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product upright and centered-stable, consistent slight 3/4 hero angle for packshot-style screens, true-to-life scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: light oak wood floor #D9B98F, matte white tabletop, soft white bedding textiles #F7F5F2
